name: Status 31 Choice
definition: Choice of formats for the specification of the status.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Status of the transfer cancellation is accepted or sent to next party.

Rejected.name: Rejected
Rejected.definition: Status of the transfer cancellation is rejected.

Complete.name: Complete
Complete.definition: Status of the transfer cancellation is complete. The cancellation instruction has been accepted and processed, the cancellation is complete.

Pending.name: Pending
Pending.definition: Status of the transfer cancellation is pending.
